_info: Source de traduction de Better Weaponry. Les noms d'armes sont construits avec 'pattern' : {type} et {material} sont remplacés par les noms ci-dessous ({type|lower} = première lettre en minuscule). Un matériau peut avoir une forme par genre (clé = 'gender' du type) et son propre 'pattern'. 'overrides' force le nom d'un objet précis. Après modification : gradlew runData.

strings.better_weaponry.tooltip.ability.parry.du: Also parries with a weapon in each hand
strings.better_weaponry.tooltip.ability.dash.inp: Goes in the direction you are moving
strings.better_weaponry.tooltip.combo.requires_d: Combo with the same weapon in each hand
strings.better_weaponry.data.problems.header: [Better Weaponry] %s problem(s) in the weapon files:
strings.better_weaponry.data.problem.not_an_obje: %1$s: the file must contain a JSON object { ... }, file ignored
strings.better_weaponry.data.problem.io: %1$s: the file could not be read (%2$s)
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.format_vers: Version of the file format. Leave it at 1.
true: while the weapon is in the main hand, the off hand is hidden and cannot be used, and the weapon cannot be dual wielded.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.attack_spee: Attacks per second at full strength (vanilla sword: 1.6). Above 2, part of the hits on a single target are lost to its invulnerability time.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.attack_reac: How far away you can hit entities, in blocks (vanilla: 3).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.base_damage: Damage of the wooden version, as shown on the tooltip. Each material multiplies it by its own factor (stone ×1.25, iron ×1.5, diamond ×1.75, netherite ×2, gold ×1) and rounds it to the nearest half point.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.material_da: Forces the damage of some materials, for example { "golden": 6 }. Materials that are not listed use base_damage × their factor.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.armor_penet: Percentage of the target's armor ignored by this weapon's hits (0 = armor works normally, 100 = armor is ignored). Melee hits only. Shown on the tooltip when above 0.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.disables_sh: true: like an axe, a hit on a raised shield disables it for 5 seconds.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.on_hit_effe: Effects given to the target that is hit, for example slowness. List of objects: [ { "effect": "minecraft:slowness", "duration_seconds": 2 } ].
Id of the effect, for example minecraft:slowness, minecraft:weakness or minecraft:poison.
Duration of the effect, in seconds.
Level of the effect (1 = Slowness I, 2 = Slowness II...).
Chance to give the effect on each hit, in % (100 = always).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.sweep.help: The sweep attack that also hits the enemies around the target (fully charged hit, on the ground, without sprinting).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.sweep.enabl: false: this weapon never makes a sweep attack (thrusting weapons).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.sweep.radiu: Size of the zone around the target, in blocks (vanilla sword: 1). Still limited by the attack reach.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.sweep.damag: Damage of the sweep attack, in % of the weapon's damage (0 = 1 damage, like a vanilla sword without Sweeping Edge). Adds up with Sweeping Edge.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.ability.hel: What a right click does with this weapon in the main hand: "parry" (hold to block part of the damage, like swords in Minecraft 1.8), "dash" (a quick leap) or "none" (the right click keeps its normal action).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.help: Settings of the parry, used when ability is "parry". While right click is held, you move slowly and the hits you take from the front are reduced. Only works with the off hand empty, with a two-handed weapon, or with a weapon in the off hand if while_dual_wielding is true. A shield in the off hand is raised instead.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.damag: Part of the damage blocked, in % (100 = no damage). Hits from behind, falls, fire, poison and other damage that a shield cannot block are not reduced.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.durab: Durability lost per point of damage blocked, rounded, at least 1 per parried hit (0 = parrying never wears the weapon out).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.while: true: the parry also works with a weapon in the off hand (made for the sais). false: the off hand must be empty.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.help: Settings of the dash, used when ability is "dash". A right click throws you forward, then the weapon type has a cooldown (shown on the hotbar, shared by every material). Only works with the off hand empty or holding a weapon, never while riding, gliding with an elytra or in water or lava.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.distan: Approximate length of the dash on flat ground, in blocks. Farther on ice or in mid-air.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.cooldo: Time before the next dash, in seconds. Shared by every material of this weapon type.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.direct: "look": where you are looking (lunge). "input": where you are moving with the movement keys, for example sideways to dodge; forward if no key is held.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.allow_: true: the dash also works while jumping or falling. false: you must be on the ground.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.hunger: Food used by each dash, in food points (1 = half a drumstick; a sprint jump uses about 0.05). Above 0, the dash is impossible when the hunger bar is at 3 drumsticks or less, like sprinting.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.help: A series of hits that repeats, with special hits. Each hit that lands moves the combo forward; a swing that hits nothing does not count. Special hits are always made with the main-hand weapon.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.enabl: true: this weapon has a combo.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.requi: true: the combo only exists with the same weapon type in the other hand (dual wielding). false: the combo also works with this weapon alone.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.reset: The combo starts over after this many seconds without landing a hit. Switching weapons also resets it.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.min_c: A hit charged below this percentage (attack indicator under the crosshair) resets the combo, so spamming clicks does not work. 0 = every hit counts.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.steps: The hits of the combo, in order; after the last one, it starts over. {} = normal hit. Example: [ {}, {}, { "radius": 3.5, "angle": 360 } ] = the 3rd hit strikes all around.
true: if the off hand holds the same weapon type, this hit strikes with both weapons at once: both arms swing, damage = average of the two weapons, effects and wear of both weapons.
0 = normal hit on the target. Above 0, the hit also strikes every enemy within this distance, in blocks, and replaces the sweep attack.
Width of the area in front of you, in degrees (90 = narrow cone, 180 = half circle, 360 = all around). Only used with a radius.
Damage of this hit × this value (1 = normal, 1.5 = 50% more).
Extra knockback of this hit, in levels of the Knockback enchantment (1 = like Knockback I).
Cooldown of the next hit × this value (1.6 = 60% longer): a strong finisher takes time to recover from.
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.format_versi: Version of the file format. Leave it at 1.
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.dual_wield_s: Attack speed multiplier while holding a weapon in each hand (1.5 = 50% faster).
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.dual_wield_i: How long a target ignores new hits after a hit made while holding a weapon in each hand, in seconds (vanilla: 0.5). Lower values let fast weapons such as daggers land every hit.
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.parry_enable: false: no weapon can parry, whatever its file says (the right click keeps its normal action). Also turns off perfect parries and guard breaks.
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.dash_enabled: false: no weapon can dash, whatever its file says (the right click keeps its normal action).
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.combos_enabl: false: no weapon has a combo, whatever its file says.
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.title: Better Weaponry: weapon settings
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.intro: This folder changes the stats of the Better Weaponry weapons for all your worlds. Your files only contain what you change: everything else keeps the mod's default values, even after an update.
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.folders:
What is in this folder:
  weapons/          one file per weapon type: add the fields you want to change.
  rules.json        global rules (dual wielding...).
  defaults/         the mod's default values, rewritten at every launch. Read them and copy fields from them, but do not edit them.
  *.schema.json     used by code editors such as VS Code: autocompletion, help when hovering a field, errors underlined.
  README.txt        this file, rewritten at every launch in the game's language.
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.errors: If a value is invalid (wrong type, out of range), it is ignored and the previous value is kept. Errors are shown in the chat to operators and to the host of a single-player game, and written to logs/latest.log. Comments starting with // are allowed, and so are keys starting with _ (for example "_note").
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.weapon_fields: Fields of a weapon file (all optional):
strings.better_weaponry.editor.title: Better Weaponry: weapon editor
strings.better_weaponry.editor.codex_note: Codex: read only. Operators can change the stats with /betterweaponry editor.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.client.note: Your own display preferences, saved on this computer.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.reset_field: Back to the mod's default value
strings.better_weaponry.editor.save.tooltip: Write the changes (only the values that differ from the lower layers are written).
strings.better_weaponry.editor.target.tooltip: Where the changes are saved. All worlds: config/better_weaponry (on a server, the server's folder). This world: a data pack of this world, which has priority over everything else.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.target.main_menu: From the main menu, the changes apply to all worlds (config/better_weaponry).
strings.better_weaponry.editor.copy.tooltip: Copy what differs from the mod's default values, as JSON, to share it or paste it into a file.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.paste.tooltip: Apply the JSON of the clipboard to this file. Invalid fields are ignored.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.reset.tooltip: Put every value of this file back to the mod's default values (kept only if you click Save).
strings.better_weaponry.editor.info.client: These settings only change what you see.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.status.fix_invali: Some values are invalid (in red): fix them before saving.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.status.saved_loca: Saved in %s. The changes apply when a world is loaded.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.status.paste_inva: The clipboard does not contain a JSON object { ... }.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.status.pasted: JSON pasted. Click Save to keep it.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.status.reset: Default values restored. Click Save to keep them.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.status.unsaved: Unsaved changes: click Done again to quit without saving.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.no_permission: Only operators can change the weapon settings.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.unreadable: The data sent for %s could not be read.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.write_failed: The file could not be written: %s
strings.better_weaponry.editor.overridden: Overridden by a setting with a higher priority: %s
strings.better_weaponry.command.no_permission: Only operators can open the editor. Use /betterweaponry codex to read the weapon stats.
strings.better_weaponry.command.dps.header: DPS at full charge (vanilla iron sword: %s):
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.combat_chang: false: back to vanilla combat. Turns off every system below at once (reach, sweep, armor penetration, on-hit effects, two-handed, dual wield, parry, dash, combos). The weapons stay in the game with their own damage and attack speed.
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.reach_enable: false: every weapon has the normal reach of a player (attack_reach is ignored).
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.sweep_enable: false: weapons sweep exactly like a vanilla sword (the sweep object is ignored).
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.armor_penetr: false: no weapon ignores armor, whatever its file says.
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.on_hit_effec: false: weapons never give effects to their target (on_hit_effects is ignored).
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.shield_disab: false: the mod's weapons no longer disable raised shields (disables_shield is ignored).
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.two_handed_e: false: no weapon locks the off hand (two_handed is ignored).
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.dual_wield_e: false: holding a weapon in each hand gives nothing: only the main hand attacks.
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.perfect_parr: false: a hit taken at the very start of a parry is only reduced like any other.
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.guard_break_: false: axes and weapons that disable shields no longer interrupt a parry.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.external_combat_m: %s has its own combos, reach, dual wield and two-handed systems. The switches and the combat settings here are saved but have no effect. Weapons and enchantments still work.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dual_wielde: true: this weapon can be used with another dual-wielded weapon in the other hand (hits alternate between the hands, and attacks are faster). Both weapons need this option. Ignored if the weapon is two-handed.
strings.better_weaponry.tooltip.ability.parry.pe: Perfect parry: blocks everything for the first %s s
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.perfe: At the very start of a parry, how long a hit is blocked entirely, without wearing the weapon, in seconds. 0: never.
After the window, how long before raising the guard can open a new one, in seconds. Prevents spamming the right click.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.guard: How long this weapon cannot parry after being hit by an axe or a weapon that disables shields, in seconds. A perfect parry is never broken. 0: this weapon's guard never breaks.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.items.help: Other items that behave like this weapon, separated by commas: item ids, or tags starting with #. They get its parry or dash, combo, effects, sweep, armor penetration, two-handed and dual wield settings, but keep their own damage, speed and reach. The mod's own weapons are never changed.
strings.better_weaponry.data.problem.item_confli: %1$s › items: %2$s is already used by %3$s (ignored here)
strings.better_weaponry.editor.tooltips.note.too: Your own display preferences, saved on this computer. You can change the key in Options > Controls > Key Binds.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.tooltips.preset.d: Main stats visible, the rest behind the key.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.tooltips.preset.a: Every line is shown, no key needed.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.tooltips.preset.m: Only reach, damage and attack speed.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.hud.title: Place the interface
strings.better_weaponry.editor.hud.instructions: Drag each element with the mouse
strings.better_weaponry.editor.hud.open_layout: Place the elements on the screen...
strings.better_weaponry.editor.hud.element.combo: Shows the hits of the combo once it has started.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.hud.element.guard: Shows how long your weapon cannot parry after a guard break.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.hud.element.abili: Shows the key and the time left while an ability is recharging.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.hud.style.tooltip: How the combo progress is drawn. The ring goes around the crosshair until you move it.
Debug view for adjusting weapons: white circle = reach, cyan = combo zones (gold for the next hit), green box = sweep zone around the target.
strings.better_weaponry.tooltip.ability.parry.pe: After a perfect parry: +%s%% damage on the next hit
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.perfe: Damage bonus after a perfect parry
After a perfect parry, extra damage on your next melee hit, in %. 0: no bonus.
How long the bonus stays available if you do not hit, in seconds.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.info.gear: Settings for shields, bows, crossbows and loot.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.format_versio: Version of the file format. Leave it at 1.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.shield_perfec: Once the shield is up, how long a hit counts as a perfect parry, in seconds. 0: never.
After the window, how long before raising the shield can open a new one, in seconds.
Damage bonus after a shield perfect parry
Extra damage on your next melee hit after a perfect parry with a shield, in %. 0: no bonus.
How long this bonus stays available if you do not hit, in seconds.
How far a perfect parry with a shield pushes back a melee attacker. 0: no push.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.reflect_arrow: true: an arrow stopped by a perfect parry with a shield flies back to its shooter.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.replace_vanil: Replace vanilla gear in loot and trades
true: loot and villagers give the mod's versions instead of the vanilla item.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.loot_upgrade_: In loot, starting from wood, chance in % of moving up to the next material (gold, stone, iron, diamond, netherite). Rolled again at each step.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.enchanted_boo: Chance in % for a chest of the Nether or the End to hold a book with one of the mod's enchantments.
strings.enchantment.better_weaponry.reflective.d: A perfect parry sends 10/20/30% of a melee attack back at the attacker, along with its effects, then the item goes on cooldown. Goes on shields and on anything that can parry. Incompatible with Riposte.
strings.enchantment.better_weaponry.vampirism.de: Heals you for part of the melee damage you deal. The healing grows more and more slowly on big hits. Incompatible with Bleeding.
strings.enchantment.better_weaponry.riposte.desc: After a perfect parry, your next hit deals 25/50/75% more damage, on top of the usual bonus. Incompatible with Reflective.
strings.enchantment.better_weaponry.execution.de: Deals 10/20/30% more damage to targets below 30% of their health.
strings.enchantment.better_weaponry.bleeding.des: Fully charged hits make the target bleed for 2/3/4 seconds. Sickles, scythes and katanas only. Skeletons are immune. Incompatible with Fire Aspect and Vampirism.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.reflective_co: After Reflective sends damage back, how long the weapon or shield is on cooldown, in seconds. 0: none.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.projectile_sp: Multiplier of the projectile speed of bows and crossbows, by material id, e.g. {"iron": 1.2}. Arrow damage depends on this speed: 1 is the vanilla bow, the stone one. Materials not listed use their damage multiplier minus 0.34.
Highest speed multiplier, whatever the material. Arrow damage depends on speed: this keeps very strong modded materials under control.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.golden_draw_t: Draw or load time of golden bows and crossbows compared to vanilla. 0.5: twice as fast.
strings.enchantment.better_weaponry.returning.de: Shurikens that land fly back to you like a Loyalty trident and give their durability back. Incompatible with Mending.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.shurikens.hel: Settings of the shurikens. Each throw uses 1 durability, picking the shuriken up gives it back. The material changes the speed, like for bows.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.shurikens.thr: Speed of a stone shuriken. A fully drawn arrow flies at 3. Damage depends on speed.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.shurikens.bas: Multiplied by the speed on impact, then rounded up. An arrow has 2.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.shurikens.coo: Time before you can throw this shuriken again, in seconds.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.help: Weapons and behavior of mobs. No more mobs are armed than in vanilla: only a mob that would get a vanilla weapon or tool can get a weapon of the mod instead.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.upgrade_: Chance in % of moving up to the next material, rolled again at each step and 1.5 times higher on Hard. Limited to iron in the Overworld, diamond in the Nether and the End, one step more on Hard (not in the End).
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.modded_w: Chance in % that a vanilla weapon or tool held by a hostile mob becomes a weapon of the mod. 0: mobs keep their vanilla weapons.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.dual_wie: Among mobs that get a weapon of the mod, chance in % of having one in each hand. The off-hand weapon is never dropped.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.ninja_sk: Chance in % that a skeleton throws shurikens instead of shooting a bow.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.captain_: true: patrol and raid captains carry a shield of the mod in their off hand. It is never dropped.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.guard_ch: Each second near its target, chance in % that a mob with a shield or a parrying weapon raises its guard. An axe breaks it.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.info.comparison: Click a column to sort the weapons.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.preset.applied: %s applied. Nothing changes until you save.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.preset.near_vanil: Weapons keep their stats, reach and sweep. No armor penetration, on-hit effects, two-handed, dual wield, parry, dash or combos. Mobs go back to their default settings.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.preset.pvp_1_8.to: Only the simple 1.8 parry: no perfect parry, guard break, weapon reach, sweep or other system. The attack cooldown itself stays that of current Minecraft. Mobs go back to their default settings.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.preset.hard.toolt: Every system on, slower dual wield and vanilla hit protection. Mobs are better armed, wield more mod weapons, guard twice as often and include more ninjas.
strings.better_weaponry.info.two_handed: Two-handed: your off hand must stay empty to use this weapon.
strings.better_weaponry.info.dual_wielded: Dual wield: hold one of these weapons in each hand. Hits alternate between hands and come faster.
strings.better_weaponry.info.parry: Parry: hold right click to reduce hits from the front. A hit at the very start of the parry is blocked entirely. Axes break your guard.
strings.better_weaponry.info.dash: Dash: right click to dash forward. All materials of this weapon share the cooldown.
strings.better_weaponry.info.combo: Combo: consecutive hits follow a sequence of special attacks, shown on screen.
strings.better_weaponry.info.shield: Raise it just before a hit for a perfect parry: arrows go back to the shooter and melee attackers are pushed away.
strings.better_weaponry.info.shield.simple: Blocks hits from the front, like the vanilla shield. Its durability depends on its material.
strings.better_weaponry.info.ranged: Only the projectile speed depends on the material: arrow damage follows it. Gold loads twice as fast but shoots slower.
strings.better_weaponry.info.shuriken: Right click to throw. Each throw costs 1 durability; picking the shuriken back up returns it. Throwing the last point destroys the item, and picking that shuriken up brings it back.
strings.better_weaponry.editor.info.tutorials: Short animated scenes that show each combat system.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.two_handed.lock: While one is in your main hand, your off hand is locked: what it holds is hidden and cannot be used.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.two_handed.one_: A one-handed weapon leaves the other hand free, for a shield for example.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.dual_wield.intr: Dual-wielded weapons can be held one in each hand.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.dual_wield.alte: Your hits alternate between the two hands.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.dual_wield.spee: They come %s times faster, and each hand uses the stats of its own weapon.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.dual_wield.only: Only weapons marked "Dual wielded" can be used this way.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.parry.title: Parrying
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.parry.intro: Hold right click with a parrying weapon to raise your guard.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.parry.front: Hits from the front are reduced by %s %%.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.parry.behind: A hit in the back is not parried.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.parry.wear: Each parried hit wears the weapon a little.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.perfect_parry.i: A hit taken at the very start of a parry is blocked entirely and does not wear the weapon.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.perfect_parry.t: The window lasts %s s. Here the hit lands inside it: perfect parry!
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.perfect_parry.l: If the hit comes after the window, it is a normal parry. Raising your guard again and again does not reopen it right away.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.perfect_parry.b: After a perfect parry, your next hit deals %s %% more damage.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.guard_break.int: Axes and some heavy weapons can break your guard.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.guard_break.bro: The hit is still reduced, but your guard drops and you cannot parry for %s s.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.guard_break.per: A perfect parry is never broken.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.reach.title: Attack reach
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.reach.intro: Reach is how far you can hit. The circle shows it.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.reach.short: This dagger reaches %s blocks: the enemy is too far.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.reach.long: The spear reaches %s blocks: the same enemy is hit.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.reach.mobs: Mobs also respect the reach of their weapon.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.attack_zone.int: A sweeping hit also strikes the enemies around your target.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.attack_zone.rad: The size of this area depends on the weapon: %s blocks for the scythe.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.attack_zone.are: The special hits of combos strike an area around you: here %s blocks over %s°. Only enemies inside are hit.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.armor_penetrati: This hammer deals %s damage. This zombie wears a full set of iron armor.
Without penetration, the armor only lets %s damage through.
With %s %% penetration, the armor absorbs less: %s damage gets through.
Compare this value between weapons on the Comparison page.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.dash.title: Dash
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.dash.intro: Right click with a dash weapon to launch yourself forward.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.dash.cooldown: The dash recharges in %s s, shared by all materials of this weapon.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.dash.direction: Depending on the weapon, the dash follows your view or your movement keys.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.combos.title: Combos
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.combos.intro: Some weapons chain a series of hits when you strike in rhythm.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.combos.hits: Each hit that lands advances the combo, shown on screen.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.combos.finisher: The last hit strikes a whole area: %s blocks over %s°.
strings.better_weaponry.tutorial.combos.reset: If you do not hit for %s s, the combo starts over.
